Fixed rapidly flashing arrow on Chaos Font toast notification
Fixed the color palette on Arcane Staff
Fixed a couple instances of mouse input bypassing the freezeframe effect
Fixed the position of particle effects after a freezeframe
Fixed a typo in the unlock requirement for Undertaker III
Fixed "Harvesting" boss mod
Fixed a rare crash related to Yesterking and the first stage of the quest being a special stage
Fixed Diamond armor not counting for Matching Metals achievement
Fixed a visual glitch related to re-rolling mods on an Immutable stage
Fixed a potential issue related to Warning Sign when used with few empty cells remaining
Fixed final cutscene not respecting custom cursor setting
Fixed Q5 cutscene alert getting stuck if the cutscene is skipped
Familiars can now collect glints
Rewrote a couple Hero Trial scripts, which may fix a longstanding crash related to restarting the Hero Trial
Gnarled Branch now correctly triggers on magic use rather than mana depletion
Improved click detection with Dirty Soap
Created workaround for rare crash that occurred when daily mission progress was not properly reset
The nomad that purchases your items will now verify that the transaction was successful before awarding coins (prevents infinites like Doughnut + another omen)
Fixed certain lingering properties when an item transforms into another item
Fixed Stake not updating the HUD
Fixed Metagate cell pressed down sprite
Android only: Picking up items on the board now operates on a longtap, allowing you to see the item description with a short tap

notes.title: DemonCrawl is Now on Patreon! Earn Exclusive Cosmetics
notes.content:
Hi folks,

We are very excited to announce that DemonCrawl is now on Patreon!

https://www.patreon.com/thereforegames


By pledging your support, you will receive exclusive cosmetics, access to our brand-new closed beta program, fancy Discord roles, and even the opportunity to help us design new items for the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/0bfa54e31577567333a1ae537ae105328f4f0b06.png

Availability is limited! If any of our benefits interest you, feel free to stop reading here and check out the Patreon page for more info!

--

Since DemonCrawl's debut last November, we have produced over 50 updates, including a massive expansion as well as an alternate gamemode with 100% solvable boards. All of these updates are completely free for owners of the base game.

And you know what we realized? We want to keep doing it this way.

We don't really want to charge for DLC, or subscription passes, or even for expansions. We like the idea of keeping the DemonCrawl community together in terms of what content we all have access to. When you play DemonCrawl, we want you to feel like there's always something new around the corner and you're not going to get nickel-and-dimed for it.

That's why Patreon seems like a perfect fit. It could allow us to work on DemonCrawl for years to come!

If you like our approach to monetization, please consider showing us that we have a viable strategy by pledging your support. You truly make this possible.

Thank you so much, and we hope you look forward to more updates soon! {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/63eabf19bdba097f7ebd5e163e87352f5c446c5c.png

notes.title: Introducing a New Boss: The HECKASLUG!
notes.content:
Hi folks,

DemonCrawl's v1.48 patch is just around the corner! While it mainly serves to address balance issues regarding stage mods and masteries, it will also contain some very exciting new content. In fact, it is our largest update since the Sweeping Heights expansion!

Today, we would like to show you a new boss we have been working on. He's called the Heckaslug, and we must warn you - he's a little bit toxic. (His heart is in the right place though.)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/4f7e521039d71c2e3870aa83f754bfaffc13a8a9.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/6620de2d896dbc425cecc3a00671807e261b18bc.gif

HECKASLUG, THE POISON MONGER
Gain Poison whenever a Dark Heart is collected.
Whenever you make a mistake, lose lives equal to your number of Poisons.
Creates a trail of toxic cells.


https://i.imgur.com/nlY2880.gif

For the uninitiated: Poison is an omen that causes you to lose 1 life every 60 turns. This is direct life loss, meaning it can pierce armor and other forms of defense. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/083b283e72e0b8c30733e864a90bc8f06686c944.png

While omen immunity may help you deal with the effects of Poison, it cannot protect you from Heckaslug's "on mistake" ability. Instead, consider taking advantage of omen or status effect removal. Leeches are a good option!

We hope you enjoyed this first look at the Heckaslug and look forward to facing him in v1.48 very soon.

---

notes.content:
Hi folks,

We are releasing a beefy patch for DemonCrawl that offers borderless windowed fullscreen mode! This was not an easy feature to add in GameMaker, so we hope it proves useful. :)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/a7b53eb8367908807587d2339b96d0eb9fb4569a.png


Additionally, this patch includes 7 new items, a new Lv3 emblem, several balance adjustments, and more!

We also managed to fix a few longstanding bugs - cloud sync should behave better now!

NOTE: We had to fundamentally change DemonCrawl's display rendering in order to support the new fullscreen method. Should you encounter any visual issues in this update, please send us an email and we will investigate right away. If necessary, you may adjust your display mode in the settings.ini file located at %localappdata%\demoncrawl. Thank you!

Full patch notes are below. There are some content spoilers.

---

notes.title: Sweeping Heights Expansion is Now Live! (v1.41 Patch Notes)
notes.content:
That's right - DemonCrawl's first expansion is FINALLY HERE!


We are celebrating launch week with a 15% discount for the base game. The Sweeping Heights expansion is free for all DemonCrawl players. (Sale begins at 1 PM EST.)


---

After 3 months of development, we are very excited to bring you a massive number of new features and quality-of-life changes to DemonCrawl.

The endgame has been completely overhauled with a new metaprogression system called Sigils. Use special crafting materials to optimize your Sigil and maximize your chances of beating the new super-deadly Lv3 Beyond Quests. 

Not to mention:


     7 new masteries that dramatically alter gameplay
     Over 50 new items
     The Endless Multiverse 2.0
     Bosses now have powerful boss mods
     Beyond Quest overhaul - more intricate/refined system for creating Beyond quests
     5 new special stages: the Guild, Academy, Lighthouse, Smithy, and Starpond
     4 new strangers: the Doctor, Gambler, Mage and Guide
     Ability to sell artifacts and other metaprogression materials for Tokens
New music
     Completing the daily Hero Trial now rewards you with a prizebox instead of a flat amount of Tokens
     Tons of quality of life and bug fixes


We're including the patch notes below for those who want all the nitty-gritty details. If you don't want any spoilers, feel free to stop reading and start sweeping!

---

v1.41 Patch Notes

Note: These patch notes are mostly unchanged from last week's preview post. Differences are prefixed with the following icon: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/d5dc46e7a14f81c415dfd82398fcf56ecb93a0c1.png


New Features
Beyond Mode overhaul
	Base Token cost reduced to 1
	There are now 3 different levels of emblems
		Quest length, difficulty, and material cost is determined by the emblem level
		Beyond Quests can have up to 6 stages now
			Past the 3rd stage, Beyond will utilize hybrid skins similar to Endless Multiverse
			
		Emblems give you access to new types of prizebox rewards (more below)
		Prizebox droprates have been overhauled to accommodate new reward types
		{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/d5dc46e7a14f81c415dfd82398fcf56ecb93a0c1.png 16 new emblems
		Emblem sprites have been updated to visually correspond to their level
		Each emblem is more likely to have a certain boss and sigil effect (toggle the information tooltip with right click)
		There are also exceedingly rare Mythic Emblems
			Each Mythic Emblem has specific conditions to trigger a chance at its drop
			There are unique divine items associated with each Mythic Emblem
			Mythic Emblems have specific ingredient costs
			Elemental Triumvirate is now considered a Mythic Emblem
			
		
	Worldclay removed from the game - existing Worldclay artifacts have been converted to Tokens
	New optional Beyond ingredient: Glints
		Adds beneficial properties to your Beyond run
		The Treasure Within emblem has been converted to a glint
		There are 12 different kinds of glints
		
	
Added new form of metaprogression: Sigils
	Only available in prizeboxes for Beyond runs that have been enhanced with emblems
	The level of sigil you can find corresponds to the emblem level
	Sigil effects are randomized both numerically and in terms of which effects get paired together
	The sigil's LV1 ability is an effect that activates automatically--upon certain conditions--once per stage
	The sigil's LV2 ability is a conditional, ongoing passive buff, e.g. "coins are 34% more common while you are not injured."
	The sigil's LV3 ability is an effect that improves the sigil itself, e.g. "this sigil has a 20% chance to remain charged after use."
	All sigils have a minor negative passive effect as well
	Sigils have a set durability and must be repaired using special materials once they break (more below)
	Extremely rare chance to find a shiny sigil that has 10% greater numeric values
	Every sigil has a unique appearance based on its effects
	
Added sigil crafting material: Oilstone - "Restore 50 durability to a sigil"
Added sigil crafting material: Jupiter Needle - "Reroll the impulses of a sigil."
Added sigil crafting material: Moon Bottle - "Reroll the reflexes of a sigil."
Added sigil crafting material: Saturn Square - "Reroll the numeric properties of a sigil."
Added sigil crafting material: Star of Chaos - "Upgrade a broken sigil to the next level."
Added Chaote talent that increases the maximum number of sigils you can store at a time

Endless Multiverse overhaul
	After the first dimension, Metagate gains Portal Mods
		Portal Mods increase the difficulty of the following dimension
There are currently 13 different Portal Mods in the pool
		
	You will always begin on Dimension 1
	New exclusive landmark: Vault
		You may store a certain item in the Vault
		The next time you encounter a Vault, you can retrieve your item and leave a different item in its place
		Your Vault item will persist between dimensions
		Vaults are fairly common by landmark standards; a bit less common than Signs
		
	New exclusive stranger: Guide
		Can only spawn in Metagate
		Pay him to preserve some items, stats, etc as you travel through the Dimensional Portal
		You cannot pay a Guide more than once
		
	New exclusive sub-category of legendary items: Mementos
		Mementos are only available in Endless Multiverse Item Shops for 10-20 coins
		Mementos allow you to retain some of your strength going into the next dimension, but only if you can meet special conditions
		There is a Memento designed around the gameplay mechanics of every mastery
		
	Added UI element in dimensions 2 and above that explains the properties of your current dimension
	Black Hole removed from the Token Shop
	
Hero Trial leaderboards will now track cumulative first place scores (Winner Mode)
	Leaderboard filters allow you to toggle between regular leaderboards and Winner Mode
	Earn cosmetic rewards for achieving 1, 10, and 100 points in Winner Mode
	We may perform seasonal resets for Winner Mode eventually - TBD
	
Hero Trial now rewards you with a prizebox instead of Tokens
Expanded Hero Trial effect pool
Bosses can now have Boss Mods
	There are currently 22 different Boss Mods in the pool
	In the Endless Multiverse, bosses start accumulating mods with each dimension
	In Beyond mode, bosses get a number of mods equal to your emblem level
	Bosses do not have any mods in Hard mode
	Right click to toggle between boss info and Boss Mod tooltips
	
New stranger: Doctor
	She will restore a certain amount of lives for a low price, but will collect more coins from you later when you leave the stage
	You can enlist her services multiple times, but her cost will increase sharply each time
	
New stranger: Gambler
	Pay a certain amount of coins and he will travel to a random hidden cell
	If the cell was empty, he wins the bet and keeps your money
	If the cell had a monster, the Gambler dies and you can pick up your coins along with any other coins he was holding
	Each turn, the Gambler has a chance to lose some of his held coins due to poor investments
	
New stranger: Mage
	Pay a small amount of coins and the Mage will cast a specific targeted magic item at a random location
	The magic item will still use its normal radius, i.e. Dynamite Mage will target a 3x3 area
	After casting his item, you must collect some mana before you can pay the Mage again
	Big thank you to DemonCrawl player Snorlaxxo for coming up with this awesome idea for a stranger!
	
New landmark: Barrel
	Barrels will apply anything that affects their cell to surrounding 5x5 area
	For example, if you burn a Barrel, all cells in a 5x5 area gain Burning
	They can even spread targeted magic items to the surrounding area
	Warning: familiars are dumb enough to detonate Barrels by walking into them
	
5 new special stages
	Guild
		Purchase strangers and spawn them in bubbles
		You may buy the same stranger multiple times
		Each Guild has a random selection of strangers
		
	Academy
		Replace your mastery with one of 3 random masteries
		Your new mastery will be tier 3 even if you don't have it unlocked
		It starts fully charged
		
	Lighthouse
		 Reduce the difficulty of the following stage by choosing 1 of 3 options at no cost:
		(1) Remove monsters, (2) remove a random stage mod, or (3) reduce the stage power
		 It can only affect the closest non-special stage, which encourages you to use the Lighthouse as soon as it is unlocked
		
	Smithy
		Purchase random head, body, or leg armor
		You must complete another stage before your armor is ready
		Return to the Smithy later to collect your item
		
	Starpond
		Purchase metaprogression items such as emblems and artifacts for Tokens and coins
		Found in the second half of every quest on Hard mode and above
		Does not replace an existing Item Shop
		
	
7 new masteries
	Spark - Connect the stage with electricity to solve the board in a unique way (Designed with the help of the community! <3 )
	Marksman - Create strategic cell chains to kill monsters before they can kill you
	Bubbler - Manipulate the power of bubbles to duplicate loot and solve cells
	Lumberjack - Deploy and manage Sawblades to wipe the map clean
	Undertaker - Generate a consistent supply of Bones by consuming other items
	Protagonist - Guaranteed legendaries. Enough said
	Knight - Overhauled into a completely new armor mastery
The old Knight mastery is now known as Guardian
	
52 new items
	New keyword: Chain - "Making two or more consecutive turns by clicking on cells with the same value."
	New keyword: Powerchord - "When you fully and correctly solve a cell by chording, reveal nearby cells and kill any monsters within."
	
6 new divine items
12 new stage mods
10 new avatars created by the talented Sam Caron
HUD now shows stage power at all times
New loadout editor for Masteries and Sigils
Improved the graphics of the 3 secret Endless Multiverse stages
New original music by Levi Tuoremaa for the Beyond Ego boss fight
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/d5dc46e7a14f81c415dfd82398fcf56ecb93a0c1.png Added 12 other boss songs - these only play if the boss has at least 1 mod
Added a new category to the Codex that displays your artifacts and other metaprogression items
You can now sell artifacts for Tokens
The Codex now displays how many times you have acquired each item
Replaced Codex pagination with scrollbar
A few other visual improvements to Codex interface
Added Codex tool that lets you quickly reclaim all favored slots
Added 2 Codex profile slots for a total of 5 slots
You can now click Codex stat icons to quickly search for favored items, blueprints, and divines
New heirloom crafting UI
New look for item targeting
You may now sell rare loot (i.e. artifacts, emblems) for Tokens in the Codex
Added many new terms to monster name generator
Added new rule to monster name generator that will swap certain "prefix" and "suffix" name parts on occasion
Added setting to adjust board panning sensitivity
New hard-mode specific sign messages
Added "orb" as a Library research subject
Added credits button to the options screen
Added button to reset options to defaults
Added a button to open the escape menu through the help screen
Added category to the help screen that allows you to see all of your status effects at any time
Daily Missions are now visible from the help screen
Implemented the foundation of localization support
Added translation support for item names and descriptions
Added translation support for mods
Remaining game strings have yet to be mapped to external files - more to come soon

Reworked several prestige rewards to accommodate new endgame
Prestige 3: "Gain another Daily Mission slot"
	Prestige 6: "Small chance to find a Glint when you level up"
	Prestige 9: "Starponds will have an additional item for sale"

Windows only: Added a video setting that lets you simplify the effects in the Customize screen for better performance
Windows only: Added an option that lets you confine your cursor to the game window
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/d5dc46e7a14f81c415dfd82398fcf56ecb93a0c1.png Added achievements for new masteries on Steam

	
Quality of Life
Tooltips that mention items will now produce item descriptions at the bottom of the screen
Improved design of lists shown in tooltips
"Timelord Chronos" renamed to "Chronos"
"Lost Shaman" renamed to "Spellbinder"
Improved readibility of stage title against Endless Multiverse background
Added dropshadow and rounded corners to stage thumbnails
The Silenced stage mod now disables music
Timeless stage mod now slows down the music, Withering mod speeds it up
Values exceeding 999 will be shortened to "1K" to conserve UI space in many places
Reversed the default direction of board panning controls based on user feedback
If DemonCrawl crashes during quest load, you will be prompted to start a new quest on your next load attempt
Added new animation when activating certain landmarks (e.g. Meteorites, Vaults)
Added new animation for strangers that "go away" (e.g. paying a Harbinger)
Added a "chain warning" system to indicate which cells can complete a chain-related effect
Added animation when an object moves to another cell
Updated question mark button sprite
Updated Wizard and Commander mastery sprites to differentiate them from new masteries
New sprite for Viking Helmet
New sprite for Shinobi Veil
Reloading a stage in Hard Mode will create a help menu entry about the 60-second timer penalty
Improved appearance of directional arrow on strangers (Pyro, Waterboy)
A quantity alert will appear after collecting rare loot from a chest
When you beat a classic stage, automatically reveal all monsters
Adjusted Beyond quest background image for better readability
The Codex no longer hides legendary items that were unlocked on a past prestige
Setting the toast lifespan to 0 will disable alerts entirely
Minor improvements to the following stage graphics: Womb, Arctic, Metropolis, Skies, Wonder
The inbox system now supports holograph and paint reward types
Adjusted bottom HUD spacing to prevent UI overlap
Limited the number of visible status effects in stage view, may improve performance slightly
Empty help menu pages now display "no results found" message
New player profile names are now capped to 50px in width (~12 characters) to prevent UI overlap
Clarified Double XP tooltip to let players know that it only affects Victory Award points


Balance Changes
Commander I rework to reduce accidental activation: "Unflag a cell to recruit a familiar to a nearby empty cell for 5 coins."
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/d5dc46e7a14f81c415dfd82398fcf56ecb93a0c1.png Commander II rework: "Whenever a familiar collects loot, perform a unique action based on the type of loot."
Rare loot now scales with Endless Multiverse dimensions
Rare loot modifiers now affect secondary chest rewards as well (artifacts, sigil materials)
Bosses now have a chance to dodge explosions: 50% + 5% for each boss mod
Bosses now have a chance to burst out of Frozen cells: 5% per turn + 5% for each boss mod
Bosses now have a chance to pop themselves out of bubbles: 5% per turn + 5% for each boss mod
Converted Godly Goblet from passive to magic: "[200 Mana] Lose a legendary item and gain a revive."
Pheromones rework: "Every 300 cells opened, gain a copy of an item that you have two or more of."
Chainsaw rework: "Spawn a Sawblade on target empty cell and set its lifespan to the length of your chain."
Magic Smoke Bomb mana cost increased from 150 to 200
Divine Watering Can mana cost increased from 250 to 400
Shadow Siphon mana cost increased from 90 to 120
Thornseeker mana cost increased from 70 to 90
Nightmare Gut price increased from 24 to 29
Transendence price increased from 40 to 50
Paragon Rod price increased from 50 to 80
Ouroboros price increased from 75 to 90
Evermetal price reduced from 28 to 22
Cullstone price reduced from 14 to 11
Buckshot price reduced from 17 to 14
World Wonder price reduced from 19 to 16
Wyrm Scale price reduced from 20 to 13
Holy Ring price reduced from 27 to 15
Ankh price reduced from 35 to 27
Wizard Boots price reduced from 16 to 13
Witches Brew price reduced from 23 to 17
Bloomberries price reduced from 25 to 23
Second Wind price reduced from 50 to 40
Blind Justice price reduced from 24 to 15
Reduced the base difficulty of Endless Multiverse
Items that increase the drop rate of certain strangers (e.g. Bindle) have been toned down slightly
Items that auto-complete stages (e.g. Dreamborne) no longer work in the Metagate
The "restore life" Hungry Plant now gives souls instead
Shiny monsters are less common
The item trigger script no longer evaluates items that were received during the same trigger sequence
The "Computer Simulation" emblem has a new divine reward; the old reward has been moved to the "Original Sin" emblem
Opening a chest now counts as collecting loot for the purposes of item effects
Adjusted several item crafting recipes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/d5dc46e7a14f81c415dfd82398fcf56ecb93a0c1.png The chance for Explosive mod to proc has been reduced from 50% to 30%


Bug Fixes
Fixed buggy interaction between Truthsayer Quill and Leftovers
Fixed a bug when blowing up Frozen cells containing objects
Fixed Wizard armor not counting for "Matching Metals" achievement
Abandoning a Classic stage through the escape menu will no longer remove ongoing quest data
Divine Watering Can no longer has a targetable selection
Speculative fix for rare crash involving orbs that were not initialized properly
Capped the number of simultaneous orbs to 1000 to prevent potential softlocks
Fixed Sawblade lifespan not persisting between loads
Codex profiles can no longer be switched during a quest
Fixed a crash that could occur if the alert log was full
Fixed Dark Chests not persisting between loads
Fixed Witch ability incorrectly activating on stage reload
Fixed Pyro and Waterboy direction not saving to disk in some cases
Fixed Hunter ability not saving to disk
You can no longer click on Burning cells behind the help menu
Treasure chests can no longer trigger the Explosive mod during their opening animation
Fixed level indicator not updating on end stage screen after leveling up
Fixed Beyond Mode not utilizing secret alt stages
Fixed a typo on Trust Buster
Fixed a crash related to Supply and Diamond activating when there is no space for loot
Fixed level-based legendaries interfering with the completion of "Infinite Wisdom" achievement
Fixed Shop Key activating "coins lost" script instead of "coins spent" script
Fixed Medusa Head not always unsealing the correct number of inventory slots
Fixed Divine Voucher not working correctly when used on a divine shop item
Fixed a rare issue that could cause Divine Lantern to lose its mana regardless of the gleaned cell value
Fixed a hard lock related to consuming an Extravagance while holding another Extravagance
Fixed Flawless mod not triggering "on mistake" effects when kicking the player out of the stage
Fixed Mirror not activating a few item effects such as Alcohol
Fixed a crash related to collecting a heart when you have Book of Faith without its status effect
Fixed an issue related to projectile positioning while panning and zooming at the same time
Fixed Book item effects not stacking
Fixed a couple bugs in the board autosolver that caused it to miss some solvable scenarios
Fixed tooltip flickering while panning the board
Fixed Sun Bomb not working on Frozen cells
Fixed some status effect messages not showing up after completion
Fixed Golden armor not counting toward "Matching Metals" achievement
Fixed a visual issue that could cause loot to appear above the UI layer
Fixed an issue that could cause buttons to incorrectly appear as hovered
The minimum stage size is now 4x4 to prevent weird stuff from happening
The Timeless mod now prevents the reset of mistake-based status effects
Brotherhood Crest now uses the standardized "loot move" script
Recoded a number of passive items so they may utilize the standard item trigger script
Recoded a number of status effect items for better flexibility with other effects
Updated Blessed Clasp description to clarify that it only triggers on mistakes, not other sources of damage
Improved flexibility of "auto discharge" magic item script
Fixed a glitch that allowed a Hero Trial score to be submitted even if the trial had already changed to a new one
Fixed targeted magic items with status effects becoming re-held if you managed to recharge the item before its status was over
Fixed Tunnel mod size and density persisting after stage completion
Fixed an issue with the help screen that could cause the bottom hud to become slightly misaligned
The main chest item will always appear on the left, before other possible rewards (e.g. Herbs' Potion)
Fixed fake values over 8 not showing up correctly
Fixed Contagion bypassing omen immunity
You can no longer acquire an heirloom with a full inventory
You can no longer activate Nomads that sell items if you have a full inventory
Fixed "destroy all objects" curse from Dark Chest not affecting Strangers or Landmarks
Fixed a bug related to Divine Shadowbind creating blank inventory spaces under very specific circumstances
Fixed a hard lock that occurred when a Bagman was sacrificed by a cursed cell on a stage with Baglord
Speculative fix for crash related to Shade movement on same turn as getting kicked out of stage
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/d5dc46e7a14f81c415dfd82398fcf56ecb93a0c1.png Clarified Steam mastery achievements by specifying that they only unlock on Normal or above
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/d5dc46e7a14f81c415dfd82398fcf56ecb93a0c1.png Fixed Wyrm Scale showing wrong sprite in alerts
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/d5dc46e7a14f81c415dfd82398fcf56ecb93a0c1.png Fixed open keybind bypassing Burn damage
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/d5dc46e7a14f81c415dfd82398fcf56ecb93a0c1.png Fixed Thought Bubble not deleting orbs properly upon exiting game view



What's Next?

We will spend the next couple days closely monitoring Discord and the Steam Forums for new bug reports. With an update this large, there's a good chance we will need to release a hotfix or two. We are ready to act quickly if any serious issues are discovered.

Once the dust has settled, we will turn our attention to finalizing the Android build of Sweeping Heights. Our hope is to have it ready by the end of the week. However, if we run into any unforeseen issues, we will be sure to let you know!

Finally, we wish to embark on the following projects very soon:


Translations (we have already implemented the foundation of localization support by allowing DemonCrawl to read item strings from external files.)
Additional ports (likely Nintendo Switch or iOS for starters)


...Both of which will probably require the bulk of our attention for the second half of 2020.

---

Thank you for reading, and we hope you enjoy the expansion!

https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/671516383284166746.gif

notes.title: Sweeping Heights launches June 2nd!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/dOBPthu.png

We are very excited to announce that DemonCrawl's first expansion, Sweeping Heights, will be releasing on Steam June 2nd, 2020! That's less than a couple weeks away!

Sweeping Heights is a massive content update that completely overhauls the endgame and introduces many new items, mechanics, and cosmetic rewards. After 3 months of non-stop development, we are quite pleased with the fruit of our labor, and we think you will be too.

As a way of thanking you for your tremendous support, we have decided to make Sweeping Heights available for free, forever. (You just need to own a copy of the base game.)


https://i.imgur.com/iYZKcK5.png

Some of the new features you can expect from Sweeping Heights:
 7 exciting new masteries
 Over 50 new items
 The Endless Multiverse 2.0
 Bosses now have powerful boss mods
 New metaprogression system called "Sigils." These new endgame items have randomized properties that can be rerolled using crafting materials
 Beyond Quest overhaul - more intricate/refined system for creating Beyond quests
 5 new special stages: the Guild, Academy, Lighthouse, Smithy, and Starpond
 4 new strangers: the Doctor, Gambler, Mage and Guide
 Ability to sell artifacts and other metaprogression materials for Tokens
 Completing the daily Hero Trial now rewards you with a prizebox instead of a flat amount of Tokens
 Tons of quality of life and bug fixes


...There's more, but you'll have to wait to find out ;)

Also, if you haven't seen it yet, we invite you to check out our recent trailer for the Endless Multiverse overhaul:

[previewyoutube=zBN_DtOfTy8;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you so much for reading! We will have more to share with you soon.

Stay safe.

notes.title: Introducing the Endless Multiverse 2.0!
notes.content:
We are very excited to unveil the Endless Multiverse 2.0, a complete overhaul for one of DemonCrawl's most ambitious gamemodes! 

Check out our video spotlight below:

[previewyoutube=zBN_DtOfTy8;full][/previewyoutube]

The core loop of the Multiverse has been drastically altered as follows:

 Dimensional Portals no longer require you to sacrifice items or stats to proceed. Instead, they will automatically reset your inventory and stats to starting values. (A fresh slate.)
 The Metagate will acquire a new "Portal Mod" with each dimension. These special mods will impact the difficulty of the following dimension in interesting ways.


https://i.imgur.com/K673g55.png

Meanwhile, players will gain access to a number of awesome new features, designed to mitigate losses during dimensional travel:

 New stranger: Guide - Exclusive to the Metagate. He will help you whitelist certain items or stats when you enter the Dimensional Portal. Unlike most strangers, you may only pay each Guide once.
 New legendary items: Memento - Found only in Endless Multiverse Item Shops, each Memento presents a mini-quests of sorts; if you can meet its conditions, you will receive a buff at the start of the next dimension. There is a Memento based around the mechanics of each Mastery.
 New landmark: Vault - The Vault allows you to deposit a specific item that will persist between dimensions. You can retrieve this item from the next Vault you encounter, however you must leave another item in its place.



Endless Multiverse 2.0 will be available with the release of the Sweeping Heights expansion, currently scheduled for late May to early June.

We hope you're looking forward to it as much as we are!

Hi folks,

We are releasing a new stability patch for DemonCrawl today! This version also includes a few quality of life improvements - in particular, we have added confirmation dialogs for important buttons that could be activated by mistake.

As for Android, we are running into a number of issues with GameMaker's new IAP implementation. Unfortunately, we cannot release any new patches on Android until these issues have been resolved. We spent the better part of last week looking through our code for mistakes but our efforts have turned up short. At this point, we suspect there may be a bug in the GameMaker framework itself. We wish we had better news on this front, but until we hear from GameMaker's support team, we must put mobile development on the backburner.

On the bright side, DemonCrawl's free expansion, Sweeping Heights, is coming along really well. We should have some teasers to share with you in the coming weeks. :-)

notes.title: Sweeping Heights: Announcing a FREE DemonCrawl Expansion!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/240c22247502bf908a63ba132c8d4ff6dcf17b0d.png

We are very excited to announce Sweeping Heights, an upcoming expansion for DemonCrawl that will reshape the endgame as you know it!

Sweeping Heights will be made available as a free update for all players - it's our way of saying thank you for showing so much enthusiasm and support for DemonCrawl. We could not ask for a better audience!

What can we expect?

Without spoiling too much, we can say that that the expansion will be heavily influenced by our recent community poll. Here are a few teasers:

Sweeping Heights will feature a major endgame overhaul across multiple gamemodes (Beyond, Endless Multiverse, and Hero Trial.)
Several other highly-requested features will make their way into the expansion as a secondary point of focus. New masteries? Yup. New achievements? We've got 'em in spades.
Sweeping Heights will set a standard for future DemonCrawl expansions and give us an opportunity to learn the process of developing DLC for Steam and Google Play.


When can we expect it?

We are hoping to release Sweeping Heights in about 2-3 months. Sweeping Heights is currently in the final stages of its design, and development is set to begin next week. We will announce a launch date as soon as the finish line is in sight.

Our plan is to continue releasing stability patches as we work on the expansion, but we can't make any promises as far as new content during this period - DemonCrawl is programmed by one person, and an expansion like this will require a lot of time and energy. However, we are confident that the wait will be worth it!


We are looking for artists!

Are you a talented pixel artist? If so, feel free to reach out to us at support@therefore.games with examples of your work, and we might be interested in enlisting your help with the expansion. In particular, we are eager to implement a bunch of new avatars and inventories to DemonCrawl. We may also call upon you for help with new stage graphics or item sprites, though that discussion would come later in the year.

---

Thank you for reading! We will share more news and teasers in the coming weeks.

notes.title: Feature Poll Results
notes.content:
Hi folks,

We hope you're enjoying the new DemonCrawl patch! Our main goal was to address a number of underperforming items, and so far the feedback suggests that players are happy with the changes overall. We're really glad to hear that!

However, our work's not done - we promised you poll results, and poll results are what you're gonna get.

So without further ado, let's jump into the data (remember, each player could vote for up to 3 items on this list):

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36016626/2096f7e8c2b7d05b523576c250c8a823317c3515.png

While some of the data speaks for itself, we would like to provide our own interpretation as well as a few general observations - read on if you're interested to know how these results will shape DemonCrawl's development in 2020.

A couple observations
There is a pretty significant gap between the top 5 features and everything else.
It is safe to assume that most of the users who participated in this poll already play DemonCrawl on PC, in English. Therefore, certain options such as "port to another platform" and "localize game to another language" were bound to receive few votes. We don't take this to mean that there's minimal interest in these features. We still plan to port and localize DemonCrawl in due course.


---

Moving onto specific interpretations...

New items
Items are at the core of DemonCrawl's identity, so we're really pleased that new items are the #1 priority for our playerbase! We will continue to release the occasional update that adds a handful of shiny toys, but what we really want to do is develop a proper expansion that contains 100+ items with all-new mechanics. 

We are also considering adding a new mode that limits the item pool to, say, 100-200 items for a very different gameplay experience. The pool would probably rotate on a daily or weekly basis. Let us know if this is something you would be interested in!

New quest
A new 10-stage quest? We can do that!

Also, we received feedback from a couple players who noticed that the poll didn't have an option for "new gamemode" and chose "new quest" as the closest alternative. We may end up running another poll to see which of these our community prefers - we'd be excited to work on either!

Balance changes
Admittedly, this one surprised us. We had wanted to take another pass at item balance for quite some time, but when we learned of the huge demand for it, we decided to make it a priority for v1.35.

We will continue listening to your feedback and will make an effort to include balance changes in our patches more frequently.

New Masteries
Ok, we'll get right to work on the Dead Rodent Mastery.

Jokes aside, we think new Masteries go hand-in-hand with new items. There are perhaps only a few existing mechanics that lack Masteries (e.g. Explosions, Electric), but a ton of unexplored design space for brand new mechanics. We're going to focus on the latter.

Also, we are of the mind that nearly every mechanic should have its own Mastery.

Endgame Overhaul
This is the feature we are currently the most interested in pursuing, so it is great to see that it ranks so high for our players (nearly 1 in 3 poll respondants are eager for improved endgame!)

We have big ideas for both Endless Multiverse and Beyond that should drastically increase the longevity of each mode. Stay tuned.

---

More tooltips or dictionary terms
This selection outperformed "tutorial overhaul" by a good margin, which was a little surprising. We will continue adding in-game tooltips with each patch, and probably postpone the tutorial rework 'til next year.

If you know of any terms/definitions that are unclear or outright missing, please let us know!


New in-game achievements
At the time of launch, we were limited to 100 achievements in Steam. It appears that this cap has been removed, so we can get to work on adding new achievements soon! We have literally 100s of ideas for cool and interesting challenges. If we run into another cap on Steam, we can just add the achievements to the game client itself.


Nintendo Switch port & iOS port
These were perhaps the biggest surprises for us.

Nintendo Switch port managed to snag nearly 12% of the votes. We take this to mean that there are a substantial number of PC players who would be willing to purchase DemonCrawl again on a second platform. These numbers are much higher than we expected - we are flattered.

While PS4, Mac, and Linux didn't show the same level of enthusiasm, we should reiterate that these results mainly represent the perspective of PC (Windows) players.

---

Thanks for reading! If there's anything you would like us to expand on, feel free to leave a comment below and we'll get right on it.

Here's to a great year of development ahead!

notes.title: DemonCrawl Feature Poll & Exclusive Avatars!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Over the last few weeks, we have made great progress fixing bugs throughout DemonCrawl. There are still a few issues to work out, but pretty soon we'll be ready to turn our attention to creating new and exciting content. :-)

Our question is: what new features are players most interested in? To help us answer this question, we have created a community poll that includes just about every option we could think of:

https://demoncrawl.com/poll
(You must be logged into a Google account to participate in the poll. We will not collect your email address.)

We greatly appreciate your feedback and plan to use the poll results as a guide for our development priorities in 2020. If you participate in the poll, you will be awarded a promo code for 10 Tokens. Also, depending on the turnout, we may consider running polls like this on a semi-regular basis.

---

In other news...

Partnership opportunities for content producers

We are very grateful to all the Twitch streamers--and their audiences--who have supported DemonCrawl since its launch. We want to say thank you by creating exclusive, in-game cosmetics to support your unique brands. If you are a content producer and would like to take us up on this offer, please reach out to us at support@therefore.games.

Today, we're announcing a new avatar in cooperation with Sinvicta:

https://i.imgur.com/vvxEVfr.png

We love his logo and wanted to see what it would look like when drawn in DemonCrawl's 16-bit style. We're quite happy with the results!

If you would like to obtain this avatar for yourself, please follow Sinvicta on Twitch and stay tuned for more details. Also, don't forget to check out Sinvicta's YouTube channel here, where you can find his first impressions gameplay video on DemonCrawl. Nice!

---

Lastly...

We're thinking about opening a Trello board or similar for keeping track of bugs. Our players have done a great job of posting detailed reports in the Megathread, but sometimes when you encounter a bug, it can be difficult to know if the developer is already aware--Trello could help us with that. notes.title: Straitjacket Rework! v1.31 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello! We have an exciting update for you today.

Let's get the big one out of the way first:

Straitjacket is now a beneficial armor item. A new omen called Fig Leaf is taking Straitjacket's old spot, but does not prevent you from picking up loot - Fig Leaf merely stops you from wearing armor.

We originally designed Straitjacket as a "worst case scenario" omen. We liked the idea of having an item in the pool that was universally feared--especially because most other omens can be subverted to your advantage--but players have rightfully argued that Straitjacket's lack of counterplay is bad design. We agree.

Someday, we may introduce a new omen to strike fear in the hearts of all DemonCrawl players, but for now we hope you enjoy the softer side of Straitjacket.

We have also added a new boss to the game. Introducing Baglord:

https://i.imgur.com/ZBt5R4C.png

Yes, it's the lord of bagmen himself!

Baglord will make your life more difficult by spawning cronies throughout the map. If he's in a bad mood, Baglord will slaughter his own men just to intimidate you. This dude's crazy!

BAGLORD, LORD OF BAGMEN:
Spawn a Bagman whenever a Dark Heart is collected.
Whenever a Bagman is killed, take damage equal to its empowerment value.
Bagmen cannot weaken monsters.


To top it off, we implemented an experimental new stage mod called "Fake" that causes three cells to show incorrect values... can you feel the paranoia setting in?

What's Next?

Bug fixes are our highest priority right now - there are still a few important issues we need to address. After that, we would like to run a community poll to determine which features our players are most interested in. We want to make sure we're spending our time on content that people actually care about. 2020 is going to be a great year for DemonCrawl, and it's all thanks to your support!

Full patch notes available below.

---

New Features
Added video setting to disable board rumble effect
Stage particles setting now applies to cell auras as well
New boss: Baglord
New stage mod: Fake - "Three cells have the wrong values."
New omen: Fig Leaf - "Unequip your armor. You cannot wear armor."

Balance Changes
Straitjacket has been converted to a Body Armor: "[6 Armor] You cannot pick up loot."
The Timeless mod now deals damage instead of direct life loss
Stage mods will now take the stage density into account when calculating loot droprate
Loot scaling is now capped to prevent empty, powerful stages from having Tokens in every cell
Quest completion XP is now based on the difficulty of all stages, not just the last stage
The Thrifty award now requires you to skip at least 3 special stages and gives more XP to compensate
Charitable award XP can no longer exceed Victory award XP
Bagman no longer increases damage taken from sources other than monsters
Updated default leaderboard version to v1.31

Developer Notes: We really like the idea of Token-farming builds, but realized it was a little too easy to spawn hundreds of Tokens in a stage if you knew what you were doing. With this balance change, adding mods to stages with very few monsters will have a minimal effect on loot drops. However, adding mods to a dense stage will generate more loot than ever! 

Bug Fixes
Fixed a leaderboard crash when too many results were retrieved
Improved reliability of "My Score" button
Fixed rare situation that could cause immutable landmarks to get destroyed
Frozen aura no longer affects cells with immutable landmarks
The prestige icon will no longer appear after prestige 10
Fixed a problem with indefinite-type status effects changing into different items on reload (e.g. Horseshoe)
Fixed a few more pluralization issues on item effects
Fixed Fish items not saving aura removal to disk
Fixed Wishpool not saving to disk
Fixed a softlock between Magic Dice and Earthblock
Fixed Beyond Mode token cost not resetting after removing special emblems
Fixed Cattle Prod not saving some cell properties to disk
The stage select screen is now capable of showing more than 9 mods


Enjoy!

notes.title: The Casual Mode Update! v1.27 Patch Notes
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/sRbaoXG.png

The wait is finally over!

After several weeks of development, we are excited to release one of DemonCrawl's most hotly-anticipated features: a new difficulty setting called Casual Mode that generates 100% solvable boards and completely removes omens from item chests. 

Whether you are new to minesweeper or simply don't enjoy risk management in your puzzle games, Casual Mode will allow you to fine-tune the gameplay to your exact preferences.

Here's a look at all of the options that Casual Mode ships with - these are all turned off by default:


Show Timer - Toggles the HUD timer.
More Monsters - Increases the monster count to match that of Normal Difficulty.
True Random Boards - Toggles the need to guess while solving boards.
Omens in Chests - Toggles whether omens may appear in item chests.


We encourage you to try enabling these options one-by-one as you become more familiar with DemonCrawl's unique mechanics and the different patterns in minesweeper. If you enable all 4 options, Casual Mode is virtually identical to Normal Difficulty.

Some Other Notes About Casual Mode
Since Casual Mode is all about customizing your gameplay experience, we will probably use it as a testing ground for experimental changes in the future. Well-received changes may find their way into the other difficulties!
Stage mods and objects can still create situations where you have to guess; our algorithm only tests the board for monster placement, which accounts for the vast majority of 50/50s. We may test other conditions in the future.


Other Features

As promised in our previous blog post, The Casual Mode Update is not just for new players! Let's take a look at some of the other cool things we've added:

https://i.imgur.com/ksihNKr.png

We have expanded the item pool to address a few weaknesses in certain builds. The full details are available in the patch notes below, although it might be more fun to discover the new tools as you play...

Two New Awards & Balance Changes

There are two new ways to earn XP as you complete stages:

Flagless: Gain XP for not using a single flag.
Thrifty: Gain XP for skipping special stages.


Since XP is directly tied to your overall score, we are very interested in seeing if these new awards have any impact on the leaderboards. In particular, Thrifty could lead to some cool moments where players have to decide between improving their build with an Item Shop or maximizing their score.

We also buffed a few underperforming items and increased the droprate of items set to Favored.

Solvable Boards in Classic Mode

https://i.imgur.com/ivlnWma.png

Classic players deserve a bit of love too.


A new stage mod
We have added a new positive stage mod called Trusty that guarantees solvability. The mod can show up in ANY difficulty, but it's pretty rare!


Last but not least, the Christmas Event is officially over.
Press F in chat for Christmas.


What's Next?
We're shifting our focus to bug fixes now. Expect a few stability patches this week, and keep sending us those amazing error reports. :)

---

Patch Notes

New Features
Casual Mode has been added to the game
Solvable boards can be enabled or disabled in Classic Mode
New beneficial stage mod: Trusty (stage is solvable without guessing)
New award: Flagless (earn XP for completing a stage without using flags)
New award: Thrifty (earn XP for skipping special stages)
You can now choose to start a quest with no mastery
Christmas is dead... for now


New Items
Head armor: Frozen Helmet - [3 Armor] All Frozen cells are gleaned. Fortify whenever a monster becomes frozen.
Body armor: Electric Chestplate - [5 Armor] Monsters in Electric cells deal normal damage. Fortify whenever you collect loot from an Electric cell.
Leg armor: Burning Boots - [2 Armor] Burning cells do not hurt you. Fortify whenever an object is destroyed by Burning.
Leg armor: Batwing Boots - [3 Armor] Every 50 turns, gain a random omen if you just clicked on a 3 or greater.
Consumable item: Fortune Cookie - The selected stage gains the Trusty mod.
Consumable item: Molotov - Apply Burning to random hidden cells until it lands on one without a monster.
Passive item: Hero Brooch - When you enter a stage, reduce the max power by 1. If you have a legendary item, cut the max power in half instead.
Passive item: Dark Amulet - Guarantees 3 additional Dark Hearts per stage. Collect Dark Hearts to restore 1 life and gain a random omen.
Magic item: Ice Scraper - [50/50 Mana] If target cell has Frozen, remove the aura, then solve it and all nearby cells.
Magic item: Medusa Head - [400/400 Mana] Convert all visible strangers into Spawners of the same type, then unseal an inventory slot for each stranger converted this way.


Balance Changes
If you visit an Item Shop with at least 10 coins, it will always have at least one item you can afford
Dirty Soap now blows up orbs in a 3x3 area instead of 1x1
Totem now activates every 30 turns instead of every 20
Pyromancy, Cryomancy, and Electromancy now give souls instead of restoring life
Frozen cells can now be gleaned
Somewhat increased the droprate of Favored items
Odds to find Favored items now automatically scales with the total number of items in the game
Sign messages are less likely to show the stage-specific message


Bug Fixes

Fixed a crash when using Ancient Coin after reloading a stage
Fixed a crash when using Sundial on an area with no visible cells
Pressing escape while the help screen is open no longer opens the stage quit menu
Can no longer autoflag concealed cells
Fixed Heart Key spawning new familiars instead of converting visible monsters
Increased the opacity of gleaned cells from 0.65 to 0.80
Fixed a potential issue with explosions still being able to destroy hidden immutable objects
Fixed Halo not reducing lives to match max lives
Removed irrelevant options from escape menu in Classic Mode
Nomads that want to buy your items now have a different set of greeting messages
DemonCrawl is now better at remembering your difficulty setting


Enjoy, and Happy New Year's!

If you find yourself still running into either of these errors, please let us know and we will continue to investigate. Thanks!

notes.title: Christmas Event Ending Soon, plus Some Update News!
notes.content:
Hello!

We wanted to let you know that DemonCrawl's Christmas Event will be coming to a close soon, on Tuesday, December 31st at around 4 PM EST.

The Steam Winter Sale ends shortly thereafter, so make sure to pick up your copy of DemonCrawl for 33% off before January 2nd rolls around. The 50 token Christmas gift will remain available through January 2nd as well.

There are only a couple days left to unlock your special holiday items! If you miss this opportunity, worry not - you will be able to find the same items again next year in the form of Beyond Mode drops.

---

December 31st is also when we plan to release our Casual Mode Update, which is packed with exciting new features. We're not just catering to beginners with this update - we are also adding new items to the game and addressing several balance concerns.

Here's a sneak peak of what's to come:

https://i.imgur.com/topQsPM.png

What do you think?

This new set of elemental armor seeks to fill a few gaps in the current item pool:

Frozen Helmet allows you to kinda negate the downside of Frozen cells without having to rely on aura removal (i.e. Rainbow Lens.)
There are very few items that synergize with Electric cells, so Electric Chestplate opens up the possibility for a new, lightning-themed build.
Burning Boots enables fire builds to amass survivability, which is crucial if you haven't yet come online with infinite flares.
In general, adding armors to the item pool increases the frequency at which you'll find armor during your runs.
Even if you don't encounter any elemental auras, these items are worth the asking price for their durability alone!


That's all for now! We hope you enjoyed the sneak peak, and as always, thank you so much for your support. :)

More to come soon.

notes.title: Developer Journal: Our Plans for DemonCrawl
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Hope your holiday festivities are going well. :)

We can't believe that it's already been nearly two months since we released DemonCrawl on Steam - what a wild ride!

We've been eager to write this blog post for a while now, but we needed a good opportunity to catch our breath and organize some of our thoughts. We finally got the chance.

---

History

Let's kick this off by providing some background about DemonCrawl's development:

We had the idea for DemonCrawl about 5 years ago when we were watching Path of Exile streamer Kripparrian discuss his love of minesweeper. It suddenly occurred to us that the mechanics of minesweeper would translate very well to the progression-based framework of an ARPG.

As time went on, we refined our ideas, but had trouble adapting some ARPG mechanics to DemonCrawl. Eventually we got addicted to indie darling Nuclear Throne and realized that the roguelite genre was a much better fit for our project.

The thing to know about minesweeper is that it has a component of risk management that sets it apart from many other puzzle games. We like that. The fact that it is statistically impossible to win every round is not a mark of bad design. In a game of chance, the goal is to maximize your average winrate over time through pattern recognition and a solid grasp of probabilities - Poker is another good example of this sort of game.

In our opinion, the luck factor is the main reason why minesweeper lends itself so well to the roguelite genre.

The element of chance is what gives items their meaning. When a board is 100% solvable, the optimal method of play is to ignore all items, coins, health pickups, etc, because they only slow you down; solvable boards demote loot to an unnecessary crutch, only retaining their value to those who don't yet understand how to approach the various patterns in minesweeper.


On the other hand...

Since its launch, DemonCrawl has been showcased by many awesome YouTubers and variety streamers, the reception to which has been incredibly positive and enthusiastic, beyond our wildest expectations.

We cannot express how grateful we are for all your support - just know that we strive to return the favor by continuing to develop our game in a direction that excites most players. Not with crap microtransactions, but with quality content and engine improvements.

We were certain that DemonCrawl was going to be received as a niche product, but it turns out that many people who had no prior interest in minesweeper ARE interested in our game. And for some of those players, the element of chance is a big source of frustration - we can understand why.

After giving it some thought, we believe we have come up with a solution that will alleviate the frustration without infringing on our core design principles...


Casual Mode

We are planning to introduce a new Casual difficulty that fundamentally alters the DemonCrawl formula. While this mode will be aimed at beginners, we expect that players of all skill levels may find it enjoyable from time to time.

Here is our current vision for Casual Mode:

All boards 100% solvable without guessing.
No omens from chests. (We recognize that this chance-based feature is another dealbreaker for some players.)
Ongoing, experimental changes (such as a stage mod blacklist) that seek to eliminate any aspect of gameplay perceived as stressful.


In short, Casual Mode will provide a new, relaxing way to enjoy DemonCrawl while retaining some sense of progression as you venture through the 5 quests.

We don't have a timetable for this feature yet, but it is definitely a high priority.

The interesting thing about solvable minesweeper boards is that, as far as we understand, you can't generate them programmatically. You have to generate a regular board at random, then use an algorithm after-the-fact to determine if the board is solvable. If not, throw it out and try again.


What about Tokens?

Another common criticism we've seen is that of Token acquisition. We have a somewhat mixed view on Tokens. If you disagree with any of the points we're about to outline below, feel free to comment with your thoughts - we are absolutely open to constructive criticism.

Presently, our view is that 1) earning Tokens is too slow in the early game, and that 2) many cosmetics are a bit too expensive.

However, we feel that the prices of gameplay-related unlocks are actually quite reasonable. We can't help but notice that most of the critical feedback we've received in regard to Tokens has not accounted for numerous methods of acquisition, such as:

Daily Missions unlocked at level 25.
10x Tokens every 10 levels.
Around 15,000 XP worth of achievements.
Prestige bonuses that increase level-up rewards from [1-3] to [4-6] Tokens.
Daily Hero Trial worth 10 Tokens after Hard Mode.
Rare chance to find Mega Tokens worth 10-30 Tokens.


It's also important to mention that Masteries are one of the only Token purchases that have any impact on gameplay. Each Mastery costs 60 Tokens, but they are split into 3 Tiers, meaning you don't need to acquire or spend all of the Tokens at once.

Cosmetics, on the other hand, are probably in need of a price reduction. Holographs and Inventories are 100 Tokens a pop, and while we do like to think of them as "luxury items," there are many to collect, and we plan to introduce many more. A better pricing model is in order here.

Also, we definitely recognize that earning Tokens in the earlygame can be a bit difficult sometimes. Leveling up relies on completing stages, which is a tough task if you don't have a Mastery or much experience with minesweeper.

We think Casual Mode will help with this to some extent, but we're brainstorming other ways of aiding new players with their Token funds. One idea we're toying with right now is providing ~30 Tokens for completing the Tutorial.

Speaking of which...


Better learning tools

Since we were convinced that DemonCrawl would only appeal to minesweeper veterans, we spent as little time as possible constructing the tutorial.

Players have been quick to point out that there are all kinds of wild mechanics in DemonCrawl--as well as minesweeper fundamentals like chording--that aren't mentioned in the tutorial. We're going to fix that, probably by splitting it up into multiple missions.

We are also looking to improve the various tooltips shown in the Help interface. If you come across any language that seems unclear or vague, please let us know and we'll work to refine it.

Bonus FAQ

Before we go, we want to quickly address a few more questions we see popping up a lot in the forums and on Twitch streams:

Will DemonCrawl be ported to other platforms?
We are aiming to port DemonCrawl to Switch, Mac, Linux, iOS, and PS4 in due course, but nothing's official yet. We're hoping that we can make 1 or 2 of those ports happen in 2020.

Can I download the OST somewhere?
A lot of the music in DemonCrawl is royalty-free material and as such we're not 100% confident if we can distribute a standalone soundtrack. However, all of the audio files are accessible through localappdata after you install the game.

Are you going to add microtransactions to the game?
No.

---


Much love,
Eric at Therefore Games

notes.title: v1.24 Patch Notes

notes.title: v1.15 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello!

We hope you all had a wonderful Thanksgiving holiday!

Now that the turkey's been dealt with, we are releasing a new DemonCrawl patch that adds a hotly-requested feature: an in-game glossary. Check it out below!

https://i.imgur.com/k9HlBas.gif

New Features
A new button has been added to the HUD that allows you to view past alerts as well as a glossary of all in-game terms


Balance Changes
In light of the recent Spy II nerf, we have decided to revert the functionality of Spy I to "glean 10 cells at the start of each stage."


Developer notes: Although we are still evaluating the balance of Spy II, we recognize that the mastery's early game was quite weak since 4s rarely appear in the first few stages. Now that we've given Spy I its teeth back, we're hoping that Spies will have an easier time getting their builds off the ground. At the moment, we believe Spy II is still good in the mid-to-late game, and we like that activating it requires more of a conscious effort than it used to (chording 3s would often happen "automatically" whereas a 4 often calls for an intentional change in how you approach the board.)

Bug Fixes
Fixed a bug with Cauldron that could cause it to destroy itself
Fixed Lantern and Spybug not working toward Spy mastery unlock requirements
Fixed "Newbie's" Hero Trial effect not doing anything
Fixed a rare crash that could occur when Sawblades collided with occupied frozen cells

Fixed clear button not properly resetting the keyboard string in search fields
Fixed a crash that would occur when a familiar tried to move after you reload a quest and pop him from a bubble

notes.title: v1.12 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello!

We are releasing a small patch today to address a number of bugs and unintended item effects. We have also made a few adjustments to stranger prices based on player feedback. Enjoy!


New Features
Added keybind support for board panning (DVORAK users rejoice)


Balance Changes
Hungry Plant feeding requirement changed from [4-10] to [3-8] items
Mercenary price changed from [2-6] to [1-5] coins
Waterboy price changed from [1-4] to [1-3] coins
Blacksmith price changed from [10-20] to [10-25] coins
Elder price changed from [7-15] to [7-18] coins


Bug Fixes
Fixed buggy interaction when an orb blew up before monsters spawned into a stage
Fixed bug that allowed Thornseeker to work on revealed cells
Fixed a crash that occurred in the Bazaar if you tried to trade an item you no longer had
Fixed a crash that occurred when game tried to distribute Banked XP outside of a quest, e.g. Crafting achievement
Fixed an issue with certain Hero Trial effects evaluating cells too early, which led to inaccurate cell values in rare circumstances
Pressing backspace on a popup will no longer softlock the game
"Pre-enter-stage" items will no longer trigger when reloading a stage
Speculative fix for a crash that occurred when retrieving invalid data from Steam Cloud


We are still investigating two major issues:

There have been a few reports of Steam Cloud and Google Play Services not syncing profile data correctly. If you have recently used the cloud save feature on either platform, please let us know whether it worked for you. This is our top priority right now.
DemonCrawl crashes without error on large stages and/or stages with very few monsters. We have investigated this and determined that it's caused by GameMaker's relatively poor handling of recursive functions. The interesting thing is that such stages can be played when building DemonCrawl with GameMaker's VM interpreter, but not with YYC. This is a little surprising to us because YYC allows the game to run better in nearly every other way. We'll see what we can do to get around this problem.

notes.title: Small Hotfix for v1.09

notes.title: v1.06 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Today's patch is the biggest one we've introduced since launch! There is a lot to unpack here, so we're happy to answer any questions you might have in the comments section below.

TL;DR We are awarding every player with Tokens to compensate them for the new level-up feature described below.  If you find yourself with a bunch of extra Tokens and you don't know where they came from... well, now you do!

Let's dive in:

New Features
Every 10th level up, you will be awarded 10 Tokens instead of the normal 1-3
Added keybind support for inventory panel (defaults to "I" key)
Added in-game option to disable Steam cloud sync
Expanded the Hero Trial pool with 2 new effects
Cell contents are now preserved between freezing/unfreezing cells


Developer notes: We have retroactively awarded existing profiles with the tokens they would have earned under this new system.

Balance Changes
Increased the base Token drop rate by about 12%
Daily Missions are now unlocked at level 25 instead of 50
Armor damage calculations now happen before defense
Survivor II rework: "Heart drops have a 5% chance to become souls." -> "Find souls instead of hearts if you are injured."
Hunter II buff: "Every 70 cells you open without making a mistake, gain a Minion." -> "Every 60 cells you open without making a mistake, gain a Minion."
Pendulum: 300 Mana -> 150 Mana
Barbecue: 150 Mana -> 80 Mana
Punchbag: "Whenever you leave a special stage ... " -> "Whenever you leave an item shop ..."
Timelord Chronos now deals damage instead of direct life loss & during this boss you can collect loot to reset the timer to 0
Nerfed the music volume of Elysium a bit


Bug Fixes
Monsters trapped within Frozen cells will now decrement the monster counter, meaning you can rely on the counter to hit 0 when the stage is complete
Fixed a crash when using Blowpipe on a shiny monster
Fixed a crash that occurred when misflagging a cell on a stage that had both Judging and Flawless mods
Fixed a few ways that immutable objects could get destroyed
Fixed objects losing their immutable property between game loads
You can now reclaim Favor points from legendary items that became locked due to prestiging
Blowing up a hidden monster will now trigger "on monster kill" effects
Fixed xray effect preservation when you reload a quest (i.e. Magnifying Glass)
Fixed Endless Multiverse loop not saving properly between loads
Speculative fix for a crash related to stage destruction before particle automanager cleanup
Fixed a database issue that prevented players with IPv6 addresses from submitting scores to the leaderboards


Developer notes: We will continue to monitor your feedback about Frozen cells to determine if they can still lead to a softlock under the new logic.

If you're unsure whether your board is actually stuck, please submit a bug report along with a screenshot and we will take a look. Thanks!

We hope you enjoy the new patch!

---

Stealth hotfix #1 @ 12:30 EST: Fixed a crash in the gameplay settings due to an inventory keybind variable we forgot to instantiate.

Stealth hotfix #2 @ 2:30 EST: Fixed Dry stage mod not respecting forced loot drops, which could have resulted in crashes with certain items.

notes.title: v1.05 Patch Notes

This will be a fairly time-consuming process, so we thank you for your patience - there are all kinds of "ifs" and "gotchas" in the Frozen cell logic, so if we're not careful we could create even more bugs with the mechanic.

As always, thank you for your excellent feedback!

notes.title: v1.03 Patch Notes
notes.content:
New Features
Introduced a new keyword called "solve." An item that solves a cell will correctly flag OR unflag it.

Developer notes: previously, there were items that would "reveal a hidden cell." Some players were wondering why this effect could hit cells you've already flagged. The reason is this: if such items avoided flagged cells, it would incentivize players to flag every cell except for the few they wished to target. We believe the wording of the "solve" mechanic circumvents this problem.

Items affected by this change include: Compass, Parasol, Boomerang, Minion.

Balance Changes
Reduced the overall monster density in Quest 1 from 0.155 to 0.148
Reduced the overall monster density in Quest 2 from 0.160 to 0.158
Greedy Pig rework: "Lose a random amount of coins at the end of each stage." -> "Lose up to half your coins at the end of each stage."
Broken Rib rework: "Instead, your defense is added to damage." -> "Your defense is capped to the minimum stage power."
Pagan stage mod rework: "At the start of the stage, lose a random number of items." -> "At the start of the stage, lose up to 10 random items."
Aching, Bleeding, and Toxic stage mods can now be found in Normal difficulty
Melting and Liberated stage mods are now restricted to Hard difficulty
The first two chests opened will never contain an omen (up from 1)
After clicking on a toxic cell, the toxic aura is removed


Developer notes: we received a number of reports from players who were struggling with the first quest, so we have decided to make it (and the second quest) a bit easier. When making such changes, we want to be careful not to overshoot our goal; if Quest 1 was too easy, veteran players would not find it engaging. This is important because there are actually reasons for veterans to return to Quest 1 later in the game. For now, we will continue to monitor player feedback and make small adjustments as necessary.

We also hear you loud and clear with regard to omen design: there are some omens that offer little-to-no counterplay. Greedy Pig and Broken Rib were two such omens that would often punish you for playing correctly. We have altered their designs so that they don't completely cripple gold and defense builds. Let us know what you think.

You may have noticed that Straitjacket is unchanged. Hear us out on this: we believe it is important to have one omen in the item pool that is significantly more dangerous than the rest. It helps maintain suspense when opening chests, whereas most other (arguably better designed) omens can be subverted to a build's advantage. Straitjacket is unique in that it's pretty much always bad. It's the ultimate low roll.

It's also worth mentioning that, as we expand the item pool, Straitjacket will become increasingly rare; omen drop rates are not weighted in any way. And we would like to start adding more items to the pool relatively soon. :)


Resolved Bugs
Fixed a crash that occurred when a cell-based status effect activated on the same turn as Smog
Fixed a crash that occurred when Dreamcatcher had no space to spawn loot
Fixed certain items not activating through Gluttony
Fixed a crash related to Duster
Fixed a crash that occurred when picking up rare loot that was previously contained in a bubble
Fixed a bug where KNIGHT II wouldn't give you defense if you were wearing a helmet (don't ask)

Known Issues
We received a report that you can resume Q5 on Hard after finishing it, but we're told the issue resolves itself if you restart the client - so far we haven't been able to reproduce this
Those dang ol' Frozen cells

Enjoy!

notes.title: v1.02 Patch Notes
notes.content:

Resolved Bugs

Speculative fix for preserving stage progress between crashes


Known Issues
We still need to tackle some odd behavior with frozen cells, but other than that, we think DemonCrawl is in a fairly stable spot right now! Thank you so much for your patience as we work on any remaining issues.

In the next few days, we'd like to get started on implementing QOL features and balance changes. 

More to come soon!

notes.title: v1.01 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Today we are releasing a hotfix to address a number of bugs we've received from player reports. 

New Features
Added support for Steam screenshots (F12 by default)
Increased the max window scale from 9 to 16 to support 4k screens and beyond


Resolved Bugs
Fixed an issue with legendary items not unlocking properly
Fixed Magnifying Glass effect persisting even after the item was lost
Fixed a crash that occurred when deleting your only remaining save file
Fixed a softlock that occurred when misclicking a monster that the tutorial expected you to flag
Fixed a crash in the tutorial that occurred when you tried to right-click a coin
Fixed a crash related to using Occultic Pendant when strangers couldn't spawn
Fixed a crash when using Ouroboros
Fixed an issue with Cattle Prod that created incorrect cell values
Speculative fix for Dowsing Rod crash
Fixed KNIGHT II unlock requirements
Corrected a few typos in the achievements
You can no longer be on drugs in the credits sequence


Known Issues
We are still investigating the following bug reports:


Resuming a quest mid-stage may crash the game under specific circumstances
Frozen cells can sometimes lead to negative monster counts, however the stage should still be completable (this is not a softlock as far as we know)
Sometimes resuming a quest after a crash will set you back 1 stage


If you have encountered any such issues, please file a bug report that includes your error message as well as a brief description of what you were doing at the time of crash. (Using an item, leaving a stage, etc.)

What's next?

Once the client is more or less crash-free, we will be turning our attention to a few hotly requested features, including UI improvements (e.g. a button for leaving mid stage) and configurable keybinds. 

We're glad you're enjoying DemonCrawl and hope you will continue to provide such excellent feedback for us! :)
